ticket.subject: No module yet for 5 needs: payment-events-processor (Money Movement)
ticket.description:
Opened by seaLeye.run from a drafted plan.
App: payment-events-processor, team Money Movement, requested by Cindy R.
Profile: dev, designed for production.
What the app needs, and what in the code shows it:
  a service that runs continuously        it reads a payment stream in a loop (index.js)
  a relational database                   it writes outcomes with pg (index.js)
  a stream of events it publishes or reads KAFKA_BROKERS and payment.events (index.js)
  secrets it reads while it runs          SIGNING_KEY (index.js)
  to be reachable from inside your organization only  the README says it must never be public (README.md)
The drafted plan is attached from the developer's repo (DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md).
This is the second team to hit this boundary this month.
